Name: Buffer / follower
What it is: Unity emitter, source or op-amp follower
How the code builds it: ideal (no code) or a gain constant (2N5458 x0.95)
Design notes: First and last in a pedal; sets the impedance the guitar sees
Pedals: Buzzsaw, Feral Hound, Night Courier, Rail Bender, Slow Burn, Thunderhead, Valve Howler
Block IDs: HM-INPUT RB-INBUF TS-INPUT AD-OUT SB-BUF TH-INPUT NC-IN

Name: Coupling / interstage network
What it is: Series cap into a resistor, optionally with R || C
How the code builds it: SlowBurn::Mna, or a one-pole TPT high-pass (coeff / lowpass helpers)
Design notes: fc = 1 / (2 pi R C); a smaller cap = tighter bass (SLO 1n -> ~160 Hz)
Pedals: Feral Hound, Frostbite, Golden Haze, Ramhorn Fuzz, Slow Burn, Thunderhead
Block IDs: BM-INPUT AD-INPUT SB-INTER TH-INTER GH-IN FB-INPUT

Name: BJT gain stage
What it is: Common-emitter stage with feedback
How the code builds it: gain constant + one-pole roll-off + asymmetric tanh collector swing
Design notes: Gain ~ Rf / Rin; roll-off from the feedback cap

Name: BJT stage with diode clip
What it is: High-gain transistor stage with diodes in the feedback
How the code builds it: gain + one-pole + tanh at the diode knee
Design notes: Cascade two for Muff-style sustain

Name: Op-amp gain stage
What it is: Non-inverting 1 + Zf / Zg (Rf || Cf over Rg + Cg), or inverting
How the code builds it: OpStage::design(fs, Rf, Cf, Rg, Cg) (exact bilinear) or Mna + softRail
Design notes: Bass corner 1/(2 pi Rg Cg), top corner 1/(2 pi Rf Cf), gain 1 + Rf / Rg
Pedals: Frostbite, Rail Bender, Slow Burn, Soft Landing, Thunderhead, Twin Vise
Block IDs: RB-BOOST RB-U1A RB-U1B SB-STAGE1 TH-IC1B TH-IC2B FB-IC1A FB-IC1C TV-INPUT SL-AMP

Name: Op-amp gain stage with GBW / slew
What it is: Gain stage where the op-amp itself limits (LM308)
Design notes: Slow op-amps add the RAT fizz at high gain

Name: Op-amp with feedback clipping
What it is: Diodes / zeners / MOSFET across the feedback: the clean signal is always added back
How the code builds it: per-sample Newton on the feedback current (ValveHowler::clipFeedback, Thunderhead IC2A, FeralHound)
Design notes: Soft, amp-like clipping; asymmetric parts = even harmonics
Pedals: Buzzsaw, Feral Hound, Thunderhead, Valve Howler

Name: Diode clipper to ground
What it is: Series R into a diode pair (|| C) to ground
How the code builds it: per-sample ODE + Newton (RailBender::germaniumClipper, FeralHound HARD, Frostbite node K)
Design notes: Ge = low, soft knee; Si = 0.6 V; stacked = louder, looser

Name: Series diodes / diode gate
What it is: Anti-parallel diodes in series with the signal
Design notes: Gates small signals: sputter on decays

Name: Variable ground leg
What it is: Extra R + C from the op-amp "-" to ground
Design notes: Adds gain above 1/(2 pi R C): Fat-style bass control

Name: Treble cut / RC low-pass
What it is: Series R (pot) into a cap to ground
Design notes: RAT filter, Hobo tone, LM386 interstage
Pedals: Feral Hound, Golden Haze, Rail Bender

Name: Big Muff tone
What it is: Low-pass and high-pass legs blended by one pot
Design notes: Scoop depth set by the gap between the two corners

Name: Active treble control (TS)
What it is: Pot between the op-amp inputs, wiper to ground via C + R
Design notes: Use a reverse-log taper to spread the action

Name: Treble / Middle / Bass stack
What it is: Marshall / Soldano style passive stack
Design notes: Slope resistor and caps set the voice; follow with a ~1M load

Name: Gyrator band EQ
What it is: Op-amp gyrator resonators, boost / cut on a pot
How the code builds it: peaking biquads fitted to a nodal analysis (Buzzsaw tables)
Design notes: Fit with a Tools/Analysis script (hm2_colormix.py) for a new set of bands

Name: Multi-feedback shaping filter
What it is: Inverting op-amp with an RC network and a pot as its input
How the code builds it: SlowBurn::Mna with the op-amp as a nullor
Design notes: Frostbite PRE / POST: one knob sweeps tight-mid to full

Name: Power-amp emulation stage
What it is: Op-amp with PRESENCE / DEEP ground legs (and a gyrator)
Design notes: Amp-in-a-box finishing stage

Name: 12AX7 triode stage
What it is: Common-cathode triode: plate load, cathode R || C, Miller cap, grid stopper
Design notes: B+ 250 V, 100k plate, 1k5 cathode; the grid stopper sets the Miller roll-off

Name: LM386 power-chip clipper
What it is: LM386 with its pins 1-8 gain network
Design notes: Gain 20 open, 200 with 10u across pins 1-8

Name: JFET common-source stage
What it is: Drain R, source R || C, gate resistor
How the code builds it: CoralTide Net + JFET (square law + triode region, safeguarded Newton)
Design notes: Bias by Idss / Vp; the source bypass sets gain and bass

Name: JFET voltage-controlled resistor
What it is: JFET at Vds = 0 shunting the signal, gate fed from the control
Design notes: Feed the gate half the drain swing for linearity

Name: OTA compressor band
What it is: Inverting stage with an OTA in the feedback path
How the code builds it: TwinVise band (Newton on v/220k + Iabc tanh(...))
Design notes: kOta is behavioural; feedback detection gives ~2:1 with a soft knee

Name: Gate VCA
What it is: Smooth gain reduction in dB
Design notes: Detector first on the board, gain applied after the drives

Name: Envelope detector
What it is: Rectifier + RC attack / release
How the code builds it: behavioural one-poles from the drawn RC values
Design notes: Attack = R_charge C, release = R_discharge C

Name: Bias / current source
What it is: JFET self-biased current source
Design notes: I = Idss (1 - I Rs / |Vp|)^2

Name: Band split
What it is: Sallen-Key low-pass / high-pass pair
How the code builds it: filters from the drawn R / C
Design notes: Opposite polarity sum for 2nd-order bands

Name: Level / output network
What it is: Volume pot and output coupling
Design notes: Every pedal is calibrated to ~-18 dBFS at noon (levelScale)
Pedals: Buzzsaw, Coral Tide, Frostbite, Golden Haze, Night Courier, Rail Bender, Ramhorn Fuzz, Slow Burn, Thunderhead, Twin Vise, Valve Howler
Block IDs: BM-SUSTAIN HM-OUT RB-LEVEL TS-OUT SB-OUT TH-OUT GH-OUT NC-MIX CT-MASTER FB-OUT TV-MIX

Name: Digital delay
What it is: FV-1 style delay line
Design notes: Feedback low-pass darkens each repeat

Name: Plate reverb
What it is: Dattorro plate

Name: Modulation / extras
What it is: Wobble, tilt, mode switching, trails
